seeded.note: Candidates seeded from a research agent's web-search summaries (see data/leads); unverified until the contest file cites the Secretary of State certified list. No stance questions set yet. Research notes: Two Democrats, and the only two candidates in the primary. Statement of Vote: Simon 153,190 (84.4%), Joyce 28,372 (15.6%). In the cert-list snippet Simon's party label did not come through; the SoS party preference history shows Democratic. A Lines.com page mentioned a Heath Fulkerson, which conflicts with the two-candidate primary; disregarded. Lead, unverified: a search summary described Joyce as founder of the nonprofit Society Library, without a clear source; it is not included in facts. GAP: the shared web search budget ran out before biographical research (education, prior roles) on either candidate.
